title: catabrosa minor
intro: Catabrosa minor, commonly known as catabrosa or little shaggy-cotton grass, is a species of grass within the family Poaceae. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its ability to help in reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Catabrosa minor include its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it useful in treating pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
